behavior_problem_id: user-conditioned hierarchy/geometry mismatch in next-item prediction
next_item_hypothesis: Demonstrated failure selected: a globally assigned item SID can merge items that are interchangeable by content but have different directed train-split successor neighborhoods, so the shared first-token bucket obscures the anchor-specific next-item choice. The measured train-only longest-prefix population contains 339519 directed transitions, 323633 directed pairs, and 314605 pairs with no observed reverse event (fraction 0.9266197178950221); this supports testing direction-sensitive successor organization, but neither proves a causal prediction failure nor establishes that negative curvature is necessary. The single proposed correction is residual hierarchical quantization under negatively curved Poincare distance with a train-transition successor objective; Stage2 emits one global, item-only three-token SID, and downstream T5 Stage3 alone ranks next items. No user-specific SID is produced.

math_definition.mechanism: One content encoder produces a 32-dimensional latent; three residual vector-quantization levels each select one of 256 learned codes. Assignment uses a fixed-curvature Poincare-ball squared distance on projected residuals and projected code vectors. A train-only transition successor-distribution objective provides direction-sensitive supervision of the global item codes. The emitted global SID is (k1,k2,k3) for each item, independent of user and inference context.

fixed_geometry.clamp: Freeze delta=0.0. For u = 1 + 2*c*||x-y||^2/((1-c*||x||^2)*(1-c*||y||^2)), use arcosh(u) = log1p((u-1) + sqrt((u-1)*(u+1))); clamp u to max(u,1.0) only (equivalently max(u,1+delta) with delta=0). Never clamp to 1+positive delta.
fixed_geometry.domain_policy: Both arms map and project every distance operand to the same closed Euclidean ball ||x|| <= R, with fixed R=0.9<1; in the curved arm additionally c*R^2<1. Projection is radial: P_R(v)=v*min(1,R/max(||v||,tiny)). The encoder representation map is identical in both arms: x=P_R(z). Code vectors and every residual entering a distance are separately P_R-projected before scoring. No scored vector is allowed outside this region.
fixed_geometry.scored_squared_distance: D_c^2(x,y) = d_c(x,y)^2 = (1/c) * arcosh(1 + 2*c*||x-y||^2/((1-c*||x||^2)*(1-c*||y||^2)))^2, evaluated using the stated stable arcosh and clamp. The objective and assignment use the squared power D^2, not d. Its exact c->0 limit is D_0^2(x,y)=4*||x-y||^2; the unsquared distance tends to 2*||x-y||.
fixed_geometry.c_to_zero_rules: The single code path evaluates the continuous c->0 limit. Distance: D_0^2=4*||x-y||^2 (and unsquared d_0=2*||x-y||). Exponential map: exp_0(v)=v, the identity. Curvature-dependent projection radius (1-epsilon)/sqrt(c) is undefined at c=0 and is not used: both arms instead use the same fixed P_R with R=0.9. The scored distance's monotonicity is not affected by curvature-dependent projection because that projection is absent from the scored region; common fixed projection happens before scoring in both arms.
fixed_geometry.exp_map: For completeness, exp_0^c(v)=tanh(sqrt(c)*||v||)*v/(sqrt(c)*||v||), with value 0 at v=0; at c->0 it is the identity. The actual shared representation map is P_R(z), not a curvature-dependent radius projection.

math_definition.assignment_and_residual_order: For each item i, set r_i,1=x_i=P_R(encoder(content_i)). At each level l in {1,2,3}, compute q_i,l,j=P_R(code_l,j), s_i,l=P_R(r_i,l), assign k_i,l=argmin_j D_c^2(s_i,l,q_i,l,j), then form the straight-through selected code qhat_i,l with hard forward value q_i,l,k_i,l. Residual update order is exactly: map (none beyond the already defined representation; residual is the current residual), project r_i,l to s_i,l, assign by the squared distance, subtract the selected unprojected learned code from the current residual to obtain r_i,l+1=r_i,l-q_i,l,k_i,l. Before the next level's distance, project that updated residual; no projection is inserted between subtraction and residual storage. Reconstruction is xhat_i=P_R(sum_l q_i,l,k_i,l). The three hard assignments are the one global SID; no beam search or prefix model is used.
math_definition.assignment_gradient: Hard argmin indices are nondifferentiable. Use an explicit straight-through estimator: forward value is the hard selected code; backward derivative of qhat with respect to the encoder-side projected residual and code logits is the derivative of the soft assignment sum_j softmax(-D_c^2(s,q_j)/tau)*q_j, with stop-gradient on the hard-minus-soft correction. Thus reconstruction, commitment, and transition losses have a declared gradient path through the assignment surrogate; codebook parameters receive gradients through the soft surrogate and codebook/reconstruction terms. The integer SID export remains hard argmin.

objective.named_tensors: N items; fixed content target a_i in R^d; encoder output z_i in R^32; projected latent x_i; level codebooks C_l in R^(256x32); hard assignments k_i,l; soft assignment probabilities pi_i,l,j; reconstructed projected vector xhat_i; train-only directed transition multiset E={(a,b)}; train successor distribution p_train(b|a) estimated only from training events with longest-prefix-per-user transitions. All means below divide by the stated nonempty set cardinality. stopgrad denotes a detached target. Empty transition groups contribute zero and are omitted from transition normalization; if the full transition set is empty its term is zero. Covariance anti-collapse term is defined for N>=2; for N<2 it is zero, while normal training has N>=2.
objective.reconstruction_equation: L_rec = (1/N) * sum_{i=1}^N ||xhat_i - x_i||_2^2; target x_i is detached from the reconstruction target side, and gradients flow through xhat_i and the STE path.
objective.commitment_equation: L_commit = (1/(3N)) * sum_{i=1}^N sum_{l=1}^3 ||s_i,l - stopgrad(q_i,l,k_i,l)||_2^2; the encoder receives the residual-side gradient through STE, while codebook learning also receives the soft-assignment/codebook gradients.
objective.transition_equation: For each training anchor a with nonempty successor set S_a, let h_a be the normalized sum of level code vectors selected for item a, and let logits_ab = -D_c^2(P_R(h_a), P_R(h_b))/tau for b in the distinct training successors of a plus a fixed in-batch-independent set of all training items; define p_train(b|a)=count_train(a,b)/sum_{v:(a,v) in E}count_train(a,v). L_trans = mean over a with nonempty S_a of -sum_{b in S_a} p_train(b|a)*log softmax_{v in V_train}(logits_av). V_train is the fixed set of all training-split items; targets and counts use training events only. The logits use the same squared distance power and common fixed projection. Item representations are tied to hard SID codes with STE gradients. This is Stage2 code learning, not a ranker; no validation/test behavior, user context, or batch-dependent negatives enter it.
objective.anti_collapse: L_anti = (1/32) * sum_{d=1}^{32} max(0, 1 - Var_i(x_i[d]))^2. This latent-variance floor enters the total loss with coefficient 1 and has a direct gradient to encoder outputs before quantization, so mapping every item to one code/one latent cannot minimize the objective without paying this term. It is computed over the fixed training-item encoder pass; for a singleton group it is zero by the stated empty/small-group rule.
objective.total_equation: L = L_rec + 0.25*L_commit + 1.0*L_trans + 1.0*L_anti. Each component uses the equations and index sets above; all reductions are means as specified. No loss target is computed from a parameter-dependent prediction without detachment: content targets and empirical transition distributions are fixed, and the commitment code target is stopgrad-detached. The anti-collapse variance is a direct differentiable function of encoder outputs, not argmin assignments.
objective.target_circularity: The empirical p_train target is precomputed exclusively from train-split transitions and detached. No target distribution depends on learned codes or model scores. The stopgrad commitment target breaks the encoder/codebook target cycle; the STE is solely the declared backward surrogate, not a target update.

math_definition.protocol_freeze: No changes to existing epochs, batch size, schedule, seeds, optimizer, budget, architecture outside the declared assignment/geometry/objective mechanism, or codebook initialization. No sweep. Curvature is a scalar parameter in the same implementation; control uses c=0 limit.
math_definition.diagnostic_definitions_and_frozen_refere: valid_l1_positive_hit_rate is over 52855 frozen validation pairs (one positive plus ten negatives per anchor, seed 42, history[-1] to target), the share where anchor item's first SID token equals positive's first token. valid_l1_hard_er=10*positive_hits/negative_hits with negative_hits counted identically on ten negatives. level2_distinct_prefixes=|{(k1,k2)}| over all items. L3_collision is the share of items whose full (k1,k2,k3) is shared with another item. L3_refinement_gain is mean over items log2(|bucket(k1,k2)|/|bucket(k1,k2,k3)|). Conditional G3 uses alpha=1 and K=256; for each validation pair (anchor,target), p_pref(l)=(number of items sharing target's level-two prefix and third code l, minus one iff l is target's own third code, plus alpha)/(bucket size minus one plus alpha*K); p_hist(l)=(train-only longest-prefix successor count for anchor restricted to successors sharing target's level-two prefix and third code l, plus alpha*p_pref(l))/(restricted successor total plus alpha). G3 is mean log2(p_hist(target third code)/p_pref(target third code)); a pair with no restricted successor contributes zero; a non-finite pair is NULL. FROZEN_THRESHOLDS: valid_l1_hard_er strictly above 16.38953942232631; level2_distinct_prefixes strictly above 16145.

hyperbolic_necessity: The observed directionality makes a hierarchy of global successor neighborhoods a plausible geometry target: repeated asymmetric transitions can form nested, non-reversible successor regions, for which negatively curved distance may allocate coarse shared prefixes plus increasingly specific residual branches more efficiently than flat distance at the same 32-dimensional width. The evidence is not proof of a tree, hyperbolic necessity, or causal benefit. Necessity is established only if the matched c=0.5 arm clears the registered behavioral and SID criteria while the otherwise identical c->0 arm does not; otherwise the curvature claim is not supported.
euclidean_control: One implementation and all frozen settings are shared. Set c=0 in the same distance/exponential-map code path; use D_0^2=4||x-y||^2 and identity exp map, while retaining identical fixed P_R, architecture, parameters, initialization, codebook initialization, loss weights, optimizer, schedule, seeds, training budget, input data and evaluation. This isolates the distance geometry; no graph-only arm is introduced.
effect_site: Stage2 item code assignment and its reconstruction/commitment/transition objective only. Stage2 has no candidate-generation or ranking components. Stage3 T5 consumes the fixed global three-token SID and ranks next items.
real_trigger_measurement: The trigger is the measured train-only longest-prefix directed transition population: 339519 transitions, 323633 directed pairs, 314605 with no observed reverse (0.9266197178950221), plus mean next-item entropy 4.844072338042215 bits. These measurements motivate a direction-conditioned SID failure hypothesis, not a validation/test-derived training signal. Evaluate the frozen valid L1 metrics and downstream held-out Stage3 behavior only as registered falsification measurements.
training_only_inputs: Content embeddings/item content and training-split item transitions only. Transition counts use the legal train-only longest-prefix-per-user population. Validation/test behavior is excluded from optimization, target construction, model selection, and user context; future events, prediction-time user context, and batch composition are excluded. Validation pairs are used only for the explicitly frozen diagnostics. No prior-candidate prompt or unseen future/test interaction is used.

stage2_diagnostics.name: valid_l1_hard_er
stage2_diagnostics.direction: increase versus matched c=0 control and strictly exceed the frozen Resample reference
stage2_diagnostics.seed_rule: For each paired frozen seed, compute the difference between curved and flat arms on the identical 52855 validation pairs; criterion is true only if every registered seed's difference is at least minimum_effect and the curved-arm aggregate is strictly above the frozen reference.

stage2_diagnostics.name: level2_distinct_prefixes
stage2_diagnostics.direction: increase and strictly exceed frozen reference
stage2_diagnostics.seed_rule: For each paired frozen seed compute curved minus flat distinct (k1,k2) prefix counts over all items; criterion is true only if every seed's difference is at least minimum_effect and curved aggregate is strictly above frozen reference.

stage2_diagnostics.name: L3_refinement_gain
stage2_diagnostics.seed_rule: Compute the frozen mean per-item log2 bucket(k1,k2)/bucket(k1,k2,k3) in each arm; require paired curved-minus-flat change at least minimum_effect for every registered seed.

stage2_diagnostics.name: conditional_G3
stage2_diagnostics.seed_rule: Use exactly the specified alpha=1, K=256 conditional estimator over frozen validation pairs and train-only longest-prefix successor counts; require paired curved-minus-flat change at least minimum_effect for every registered seed.

stage2_diagnostics.name: L3_collision
stage2_diagnostics.seed_rule: Compute the frozen share of items whose full three-code SID is shared with another item; require flat-minus-curved change at least minimum_effect for every registered seed.

stage3_behavioral_test.seed_rule: Train/evaluate the same frozen Stage3 T5 protocol on the respective global SIDs, using only the already authorized held-out evaluation; compare paired seed-wise test NDCG@10 and require curved-minus-flat at least minimum_effect for every registered seed. No test data may tune Stage2 or select checkpoints.

classification.falsified_if: any registered stage2_diagnostics criterion is false OR stage3_behavioral_test criterion is false
classification.passed_if: every registered stage2_diagnostics criterion is true AND stage3_behavioral_test criterion is true
classification.mixed_if: at least one registered criterion is true AND at least one registered criterion is false

null_outcome_rule: If a seed-wise or aggregated change is undefined or non-finite, including zero denominator, missing evaluation, or empty stratum, classify that outcome NULL. Any comparison containing any NULL seed is inconclusive, neither passed nor falsified; it cannot satisfy a true criterion.
